heading: top-left
name: 分欄直列＋右欄單張圖片
desc: 左欄是標題組與有分隔線的直列，右欄只放一張置中圖片，兩欄之間以直線分隔，區塊上下緣也有橫線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上下緣各有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線，區塊分成左右兩欄，左欄約佔六成五、右欄約佔三成五，兩欄之間有一條貫穿整個區塊高度的直向分隔線。左欄上方靠左放標題組：標題（可多行），標題右側同一行可放一個很小的小標籤，沒有時省略；標題組下方留大片空白，下方的直列集中在左欄下半部。直列有多個項目，每列一筆：左側是標題，右側靠右是次要文字，兩者在同一水平線上，每列下方有一條分隔線。直列下方靠右可放一個加箭頭的文字連結，右緣和直列對齊，沒有時省略。右欄只放一張圖片，寬度約佔右欄六成，在欄內水平置中且垂直置中；圖片完整顯示，比例依各圖而定，對應其中一個項目。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，只剩單欄：右欄的圖片與兩欄之間的直向分隔線取消，區塊上下緣的分隔線保留。標題組在上方靠左，小標籤仍在標題右側；標題組下方的空白縮小。直列每列改為標題在上、次要文字在下，每列下方的分隔線保留；文字連結仍在直列下方靠右。

en.name: Split list of rows + single image column
en.desc: The left column holds the heading group and a list of rows with dividers; the right column holds one centered image. A vertical divider separates the columns, and horizontal lines run along the top and bottom edges of the section.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A divider spanning the full viewport width runs along both the top and bottom edges of the section. The section is split into two columns, the left about 65% wide and the right about 35%, separated by a vertical divider that runs the full height of the section. Place the heading group at the top of the left column, aligned left: a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a very small label on the same line to the right of the title; omit it when there is no content. Leave a large empty space below the heading group, so the list of rows below sits in the lower half of the left column. The list of rows holds multiple items, one per row: a title on the left and secondary text aligned right, on the same horizontal line, with a divider below each row. Optionally place a text link with an arrow below the list, aligned right with its right edge matching the list; omit it when there is no content. The right column holds a single image, about 60% of the column width, centered horizontally and vertically centered within the column; the image is shown in full, its aspect ratio following each image, and it corresponds to one of the items.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically into a single column: the right-column image and the vertical divider between the columns are removed, while the dividers along the top and bottom edges of the section remain. The heading group stays at the top, aligned left, with the label still to the right of the title; the empty space below the heading group becomes smaller. Each row of the list changes to the title above and the secondary text below, with the divider below each row kept; the text link stays below the list, aligned right.

extras.name: 滑過項目換右欄圖片
extras.prompt: 滑鼠滑過直列中的某一列時，右欄的圖片換成那個項目對應的圖片，圖片依各自比例完整顯示，仍在右欄內置中。
extras.mobile: 手機版右欄圖片取消，這個效果一併取消；觸控裝置上點擊項目直接前往該項目。

en.name: Hovering a row swaps the right-column image
en.prompt: When the pointer hovers over a row in the list, the image in the right column changes to the image corresponding to that item; each image is shown in full at its own aspect ratio and stays centered in the right column.
en.mobile: On mobile the right-column image is removed, so this effect is removed too; on touch devices, tapping an item goes directly to that item.
